name: Gdakon
blurb: Poland's furry convention, held each spring at a hotel in the Gdańsk/Sopot area with its own badge and fursuit community.

editions.evidence: Homepage footer: 'Gdakon • 17-21.03.2027 • Radisson Blu Hotel, Sopot'.

notes: Registration for the 2027 edition does not open until 2026-11-01, and the site's nav (participant zone, badges, hotel, important dates) has no guest-of-honor page or any guest photos — only partner-convention banner ads (Eurofurence, EAST, Awoostria, Stowarzyszenie OwO). A targeted search turned up no announced guest of honor either, so guests is 'none-yet' rather than assuming this type of con has none at all.
